name: @equin/plugin-database-pglite
description: The PGlite database driver: provides the DatabaseDriver host service with Postgres compiled to WASM (in memory, or in IndexedDB when the host declared a persistent storage), for a host without the computer's Postgres cluster — the browser composition and the portable boot test. Never booted by the desktop.

holds.reason: From 0.5.13 (checked 0.5.13, 0.5.14 and 0.5.15 on 2026-11-09) the Emscripten glue in dist/ loads Node's require with `await import("node:module")` (0.5.12 and earlier: `import("module")`), but the package.json `browser` field still maps only the bare `module` to false. A browser bundler therefore cannot drop it: the web build's vendor set (esbuild, platform browser) fails `Could not resolve "node:module"` in chunk-N66TTF7B.js / chunk-O74Z5DUS.js, so `./equin build` publishes nothing. The deps-upgrade gates (checks, tests) do not build the web bundle, so only `./equin build` catches it. Upstream fix: add `"node:module": false` to `browser` (as PR #372 did for util). No issue filed yet: filing is outward-facing and waits for the user's go (tracked on the Backlog page). Lift once a release maps it, after a successful `./equin build`.
